snippet.title: Covenant - Official Trailer 2 | Galaxies Showcase 2025
snippet.description: From developers behind Halo, Call of Duty, Battlefield, Apex Legends and Destiny is Covenant, a first-person dark fantasy combat game in which you play as a messenger sent from above. Wield martial arts, secret magic, and ancient weapons to explore a vast interconnected world.
